signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {R : Type u_2} -> {M : Type u_3} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> {A : Type u_4} -> [CommSemiring A] -> [Algebra R A] -> {I : Ideal A} -> (hI : DividedPowers I) -> (g : M →ₗ[R] A) -> (hg : ∀ (m : M), g m ∈ I) -> DividedPowerAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: All arguments carry genuine mathematical content and the map is total; there are no junk-value or out-of-domain conventions.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : DividedPowers I) (g : M →ₗ[R] A) (hg : ∀ m : M, g m ∈ I) (r : R), VTask.lift hI g hg (algebraMap R (DividedPowerAlgebra R M) r) = algebraMap R A r

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : DividedPowers I) (hg : ∀ m : M, (0 : M →ₗ[R] A) m ∈ I) (n : ℕ) (m : M), VTask.lift hI (0 : M →ₗ[R] A) hg (DividedPowerAlgebra.dp R n m) = hI.dpow n 0

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : DividedPowers I) (g : M →ₗ[R] A) (hg : ∀ m : M, g m ∈ I) (n : ℕ) (m : M), VTask.lift hI g hg (DividedPowerAlgebra.dp R n m) = hI.dpow n (g m)
